description:
**Company Description**
Maadhu Creatives is a young, dynamic miniature scale model making company serving clients globally. The team specializes in transforming ideas and concepts into highly detailed 3D miniature models using advanced technologies and proven craftsmanship. With a strong focus on quality, design, innovation, and precision, Maadhu Creatives delivers models for architecture, engineering, marine, civil, museums, theme parks, and master plans. The company’s multidisciplinary expertise and years of experience make it a preferred partner for complex scale model projects across industries.

# JOB DESCRIPTION – MARKETING HEAD

\*\*Company:\*\* Maadhu Creatives

\*\*Department:\*\* Marketing & Business Development

\*\*Designation:\*\* Marketing Head

\*\*Experience:\*\* 6–7 Years

\*\*Industry Preference:\*\* Manufacturing / Model Making / Architectural & Industrial Model Making

\*\*Location:\*\* Vasai East, Maharashtra

### Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented \*\*Marketing Head\*\* who will be responsible for driving the overall business growth and revenue of Maadhu Creatives.

The candidate will be responsible for \*\*business generation, client acquisition, strategic marketing, sales growth, team management, key client relationships, and overall revenue development\*\*. The person should have strong experience in the \*\*manufacturing/model-making industry\*\* and understand the complete business cycle from enquiry generation to project closure and client retention.

### Key Responsibilities

\* Key Responsibilities

\* Take overall responsibility for \*company business growth, revenue generation and marketing strategy\*.

\* Develop and implement strategies to increase the company's \*overall turnover and profitability\*.

\* Generate new business opportunities through direct marketing, networking, references, exhibitions, digital platforms and corporate connections.

\* Identify and develop new markets, industries, clients and business opportunities.

\* Build strong relationships with \*architects, builders, developers, infrastructure companies, industrial companies, corporates, consultants and other potential clients\*.

\* Handle and develop \*key accounts and major clients\* of the company.

\* Understand client requirements and coordinate with the internal team for quotation, feasibility, costing and project execution.

\* Monitor the complete sales cycle from \*lead generation → enquiry → quotation → negotiation → order confirmation → project handover → payment follow-up\*.

\* Develop a strong pipeline of prospective projects and ensure regular follow-up and conversion.

\* Set monthly, quarterly and annual \*sales/revenue targets\* and ensure achievement.

\* Analyse market trends, competitor activities and pricing to identify growth opportunities.

\* Prepare and monitor \*marketing and business development plans\*.

\* Manage, guide and monitor the \*Business Development / Marketing team\*.

\* Set individual targets and KRAs for team members and review their performance regularly.

\* Conduct regular review meetings and track lead generation, conversion, revenue and client development.

\* Coordinate with \*Production, Design, Project, Procurement, Finance and Management\* to ensure smooth execution of business commitments.

\* Reduce dependency on individual clients by developing a diversified client base.

\* Develop long-term strategies for \*repeat business and client retention\*.

\* Represent the company in client meetings, exhibitions, industry events and business networking platforms.

\* Prepare regular \*MIS reports covering leads, enquiries, conversion, sales, revenue and future business pipeline\*.

\* Work closely with the Director/Management on major business decisions, strategic accounts and large-value projects.### Industry-Specific Responsibilities

The candidate should preferably have experience in \*\*model-making / scale-model manufacturing / architectural models / industrial models / prototype manufacturing / fabrication / 3D printing / visualisation or related manufacturing services\*\*.

title: Social Media Marketing Intern
description:
**This role is for you if…**

You can sniff out an Instagram trend before everyone else catches on. You understand the three-second hook rule, why people stop scrolling, what makes a reel work, and how brands can show up differently on social media.

We’re looking for a Social Media Intern who lives and breathes the digital world and is excited to help turn ideas into content that people actually watch, read and engage with.

At DTDC, you’ll work closely with our Social Media Executive and support the team in executing campaigns across our key platforms. Instagram and LinkedIn take priority, followed by Facebook and YouTube.

You’ll get hands-on exposure to trending reels and topical content, campaign launches, brand storytelling, influencer collaborations and performance tracking, and see what it takes to build and grow a brand’s social media presence.

This is a hands-on role for someone who brings fresh ideas, is curious about the social media landscape and enjoys being part of the whole process: spotting trends, pitching ideas, coordinating with the design and copy teams, getting posts scheduled and tracking how they perform. You’ll learn directly from the social team along the way.

**The hats you’ll wear (key responsibilities)**

•
**The Trend Spotter:**
Keep an eye on trends and competitor pages, and flag the ones that could work for DTDC. Because not every trend needs to be our trend.

•
**The Ideas Contributor:**
Join brainstorms and pitch ideas for topical posts, reels and campaigns that make people stop scrolling.

•
**The Organiser:**
Maintain the content calendar, schedule posts and make sure everything goes live on time.

•
**The Creative Wingmate:**
Coordinate with the design, copy and video teams, follow up on deliverables and keep creatives moving to approval.

•
**The Shoot Assist:**
Help out on shoots, capture content on the office iPhone when needed and occasionally jump in front of the camera yourself.

•
**The Creator Connect:**
Support influencer and creator collaborations with outreach, follow-ups and tracking deliverables.

•
**The Numbers Keeper:**
Update the weekly performance tracker with reach, engagement, views and growth.

•
**The Team Player:**
Pitch in wherever the team needs an extra hand.

**Requirements**

1. Pursuing or recently completed a bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Media Studies or a related field.

2. Active on Instagram and LinkedIn, and follows how brands show up there.

3. Good writing skills and a creative eye.

4. Comfortable with Google Sheets, Google Slides, PowerPoint and Canva.

5. Organised, reliable with deadlines and happy to coordinate with multiple people.

6. A prior internship in social media, digital marketing or content creation is a plus, not a must.

**Extra aura points if you…**

1. Have managed a brand page, college society page or creator account.

2. Have hands-on experience assisting with content shoots and reel creation.

3. Understand LinkedIn content formats, audience behaviour and platform-specific trends.

4. Are comfortable being the face of a reel or video.

**What you’ll learn**

How brands build their presence on social media, and how campaigns move from the first idea to execution and performance tracking, guided by the social team.

**What you’ll love**

Seeing your ideas go live across DTDC’s social media platforms, working on brand campaigns with creative teams and creators, and plenty of room to experiment.

If you’re curious, full of ideas and content references, and have a knack for spotting the next big thing, we’d love to meet you.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist (Google Ads, Meta Ads & Amazon Ads)
description:
**POSITION:  Performance Marketing Specialist**

**(Google Ads, Meta Ads & Amazon Ads)**

**About Us**

Vibrant Publishers is an independent U.S. publisher of academic and test preparation books, dedicated to making learning accessible and practical. With a strong presence in business, technology, and test preparation, our books are trusted by students, educators, and professionals worldwide. We are seeking a Marketing Manager to drive our marketing and communications strategy, lead campaigns, and manage a small team, including Marketing & PR Executives.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an all-in-one Digital Marketer who has hands-on experience managing and optimizing paid campaigns across Amazon Ads, Google Ads, and Meta Ads. The ideal candidate knows how to balance search intent with creative discovery to drive maximum return on ad spend (ROAS) for our book catalog.
**US/Global market experience is must.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Amazon PPC Management:**

  Set up, monitor, and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Display ads. Conduct rigorous keyword research specific to book genres, search volumes, and competitor analysis.
* **Google Ads Execution:**

  Run high-intent Search and Performance Max (PMax) campaigns targeting students, professionals, and institutions looking for educational and career resources.
* **Meta Ads Strategy:**

  Design, execute, and copywrite target-audience campaigns on Facebook and Instagram. Build custom and lookalike audiences based on reader demographics, interests, and academic profiles.
* **Data & Optimization:**

  Monitor daily/weekly budgets across platforms. Track key metrics including ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CTR, and Cost-Per-Click (CPC).
* **Reporting:**

  Maintain clean marketing dashboards and provide data-backed insights on which titles are scaling and where budget allocation needs to shift.

**Requirements**

* 2 to 6 years of verifiable experience running paid campaigns across Google, Meta, and Amazon Ads (E-commerce or Publishing background is a major plus).
* **US/Global market experience is must.**
* Solid understanding of the Amazon ecosystem (Vendor Central / Seller Central / KDP ad dashboards).
* Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets for data slicing.
* Excellent copywriting skills to write compelling ad copy for books, titles, and blurbs.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary based on qualifications, experience, and skills.
* Opportunity to shape marketing strategy for a growing publishing house.
* Exposure to
  **international markets and global publishing trends**

* A collaborative and growth-oriented environment.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a results-driven Performance Marketing Manager to manage and optimize paid media campaigns across platforms like Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta, and other B2B channels.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a results-driven Performance Marketing Manager to own the strategy, execution, and performance of paid media programs across Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta, and other B2B channels. The ideal candidate will have a strong track record in performance marketing for B2B sectors such as pharma, life sciences, biotech, healthcare, or technology, and the ability to lead a team while staying close to the campaigns.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the paid media strategy across clients, including channel mix, budget allocation, and quarterly performance goals
* Plan, launch, and scale B2B campaigns for lead generation, ABM, retargeting, and brand awareness across Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta, and programmatic channels
* Lead keyword strategy, audience architecture, and persona-based targeting aligned to complex B2B buying committees
* Manage and optimize daily performance metrics (CPC, CTR, CPL, ROAS) and provide actionable insights
* Build and run a structured testing roadmap for ad copy, creatives, offers, bidding strategies, and landing pages
* Oversee conversion tracking, offline conversion imports, and attribution setup using Google Tag Manager, GA4, and CRM integrations
* Turn performance data into clear insights and recommendations in monthly and quarterly business reviews with clients
* Act as the primary paid media point of contact for clients, managing expectations, timelines, and growth conversations
* Lead, mentor, and review the work of Performance Marketing Executives, setting quality standards and building team capability

**How we work with AI**

Target Edge has built proprietary AI systems specifically for the craft of B2B performance

marketing, keyword and audience research, ad copy generation, creative briefing, bid

logic, and reporting analysis. You will be trained on them. We expect:

* A worldview that AI is a partner, not a threat. AI amplifies capable marketers; it does not replace them. If you believe that, this role will be one of the most leveraged of your career. If you don't, this is not the right place for you.
* Use across the full campaign cycle. AI as a research partner during planning, a drafting partner for ad copy and creative briefs, an optimization partner inside the platforms, and an analysis partner during reporting, not just a tool bolted onto the end.
* Critical judgment. Knowing when AI output sharpens a campaign and when it hurts it, and editing with intent until the work meets our standard and the client's funnel reality.
* Openness to build. You do not need an established AI workflow to apply. You need the disposition to build one with us.

**Requirements**

* 7-8 years of hands-on experience managing B2B paid ad campaigns
* Strong knowledge of Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and analytics platforms
* Experience with lead generation funnels and CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
* Solid understanding of B2B buyer journeys and persona targeting
* Proficiency in Excel/Sheets for campaign reporting and analysis
* Analytical mindset with a test-and-learn approach

Your work will directly contribute to Danfoss' ambition of becoming a preferred technology partner in India's rapidly evolving data center market.
   

  

 You will collaborate with Sales, Application Engineering, Product Management, Marketing, and Global Data Center teams while taking ownership of key customer engagements, business development initiatives, and ecosystem partnerships that support long\-term growth
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Lead business development activities to identify, qualify, and convert strategic Data Center opportunities across India.
* Build and strengthen relationships with hyperscalers, colocation operators, consultants, EPCs, OEMs, and key industry stakeholders.
* Influence project specifications and cooling architecture decisions by positioning Danfoss' energy\-efficient and sustainable solutions.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to develop customer value propositions, drive solution selling, and support major project pursuits.
* Represent Danfoss at industry forums, technical seminars, customer events, and industry associations to enhance market visibility and thought leadership.


**What We're Looking For**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, or a related field.
* Proven experience in Business Development, Key Account Management, or Sales within Data Centers, HVAC\&R, Cooling Solutions, Critical Infrastructure, or Industrial markets.
* Strong understanding of the Data Center ecosystem, including hyperscalers, colocation providers, consultants, and cooling technologies.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and build long\-term strategic relationships across multiple levels of customer organizations.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and collaboration skills with a proactive and growth\-oriented mindset.


**What You'll Get From Us**
* We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.
* You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work\-life balance. Your well\-being matters to us.
* We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.
* You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.


**Ready to Make a Difference?**
 If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Transparency**
 Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.
   

  

 The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.
   

  

 Want to know more? Please visit our FAQ Page.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

title: Product Line Specialist
description:
Requisition Number: 77922
   

  

**The company built on breakthroughs.
   

  

 Join us.**
 Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.
   

  

 How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.
   

  

 At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at\-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.
   

  

 Come break through with us.
   

  

 Corning’s Businesses Are Ever\-evolving To Best Serve Our Customers, Industries, And Consumers. Today, We Accelerate And Transform Life Sciences, Mobile Consumer Electronics, Optical Communications, Display, Automotive, And Solar Markets. We Are Changing The World With
   

  

* Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives
* Damage\-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected
* Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light
* Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences
* Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation
* Solar polysilicon, wafers, and innovative photovoltaic modules, enabling low\-cost solar energy solutions


 Purpose of Position
   

  

* Develops and executes a product line strategy that supports the achievement of desired product line sales growth and profitability


 Major Responsibility
   

  

 Works Closely With, Or Leads, a Cross\-functional Product Team Consisting Of Functional Leads From Development, Product Engineering, Applications Engineering, Manufacturing, Marketing And/or Sales To
   

  

* Develop the product or product line’s market value proposition and pricing strategy.
* Develop and execute the product line planning process, including the identification of critical projects to be undertaken for the year.
* Find the optimal solution (balancing the needs of Corning and the customer) to all product issues related to performance (i.e., specs, attributes, services), quality, share growth, customer needs (contract management)
* Create an intellectual property and standards strategy for the product line.
* Understand downstream market requirements and assess competitive threats and implications for the business.
* Create long\-term forecasting plans.
* Works with Program Management or New Business Development to ‘receive’ new products, as appropriate.
* Develops a compelling market value proposition that differentiates Corning’s products and services in the marketplace.
* Develops the product line strategy and manages the product line through the stages of innovation, from product concept through commercialization and life\-cycle management, as appropriate depending on the stage of handoff from Program Management or New Business Development
* May manage a portfolio of markets, in the case where the product line’s products hold different positions within the markets they reach.
* Identifies the best mix for the market(s) through effective segmentation and portfolio rationalization.
* Optimizes inventory management related to the product line by coordinating information flow, as needed, between Forecasting, Sales, Manufacturing, and other parties as needed.
* May get involved in supply chain disruption issues to influence or make decisions on global order and Development/Manufacturing prioritization.
* Works with Manufacturing and Sales to identify opportunities to reduce complexity and cost reduction in the manufacturing process both at Corning’s plant(s) and the customer site, as appropriate.
* Works with the Standards group to set and drive the standards strategy for the product line.
* Addresses new product/special requests by developing a business case (including P\&L and balance sheet implications) to determine the feasibility and pricing requirements of the requests.
* Owns and optimizes, or may work with the Pricing Manger to optimize, pricing levels by setting floor price, establishing pricing structure, optimizing product premiums, and ensuring value received for product line
* Works with Account Management to develop value propositions that improve margins for Corning’s products and services and enable new/enhanced selling opportunities with customers.
* Manages the obsolescence process, as necessary, to extract maximum value through the end of the product’s lifecycle.
* May oversee, develop, and direct a Product Line team.


 Education \& Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s Degree \- Technical (engineering degree or other formal engineering education)
* MBA desired
* Intermediate Project Management Skills and Practices
* Product / Process Knowledge
* Customer Knowledge


**Required Competency (Skills, Knowledge And Abilities)**
* Demonstrated track record of managing projects.
* Demonstrated track record of leading and/or actively participating in multi\-functional teams.
* Fluent English written and spoken. Knowledge of additional Asian language knowledge is a plus.
* Good knowledge of Excel spreadsheets and MS Office in general
* Optical Industry Acumen is a plus.
* Technology around the Data Center including cabling and actives/networking are a plus.
